messages:
Maya Patel: Quick recap from user tests on the batch import + vectors preview. Ran 2 sessions, couple of recurring pain points: silent CSV errors, inaccessible relevance colors, unclear upload state. Starting thread to gather fixes. :clipboard:

Samira Cho: Can you list the exact failure cases? One tester said the CSV "failed" but gave zero clues and left.

Maya Patel: Sure. 1) When CSV had missing required column, toast said 'Upload failed' with no row info. 2) When a row text exceeded token limit the preview showed '---' with no explanation. 3) Relevance heatmap uses a red->green scale that collapses contrast at extremes. 4) Tab navigation skips the preview table cells; keyboard users get lost.

Devin Lee: For #1 we should run a dry validation on file drop and show an inline per-row status column in the preview: 'ok', 'warning', 'error'. Provide an exportable errors CSV with original columns + error message. Example rows: 
```csv
row_id,text,id,error
4,"long text...",abc,"exceeds token limit (3,072)"
7,,,"missing id"
```

Alex Rivera: UX/copy: change primary CTA from 'Upload' to 'Validate & upload' when dry-run validation is enabled. Also update the preview header to 'Batch preview — inputs & validation' so it's explicit.

Samira Cho: Accessibility: heatmap needs a non-color cue. Suggest adding a small diagonal hatch icon in low relevance and solid dot for high. Also tooltips must be keyboard accessible (focusable via tab).

Marcus (QA): Add: table headers need aria-sort and focus outlines; token-pill text is too low contrast (WCAG AA fail at small size). We'll log tests for these.

Devin Lee: Implementation ideas: reuse RelevanceBar but overlay a small glyph that has aria-hidden=false and a visually-hidden label like 'Relevance score: 0.82'. Tooltip can be a focusable button with aria-describedby. Sorting: Enter on header toggles none->asc->desc and updates aria-sort.

Alex Rivera: For truncated text show an inline 'Show full' link that opens a centered modal with the full text and token breakdown. Focus trap + Escape to close. Also show the token count in a muted pill: 'tokens: 124'.

Maya Patel: Copy nit: use 'row id' not 'vector id' across the flow. Also success toast should say 'Validation passed; X warnings. Download report' with 'Download report' as link.

DesignBot: Tasks assigned: Samira - glyph mockups + accessible tooltip (2 days). Devin - aria & keyboard spec PR (1 day). Alex - copy PR + modal UX (tomorrow). Marcus - regression tests for export & a11y.

Samira Cho: Quick q: should error CSV include full original columns or just row_id + error? Testers preferred full context.

Devin Lee: Include full columns. Use filename pattern: batch-errors-<timestamp>.csv. Keep export small since it's only error rows.

Maya Patel: OK plan. We'll reconvene after mocks. Thanks :thumbsup:
